meta.method: Top-10% cited subfield papers, normalized by year, type and subfield; at least two in the three-year window and one subfield paper in the last 12 months. Candidates are the 100 leading authors by recent top-10% paper count. Ties use last-12-month publication count. Coauthors receive full credit. Collaboration links are sampled from up to 100 highly cited papers; absent links do not imply no collaboration.
